notes.title: Second small patch just went live!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone that keep sharing their feedback and suggestions! I've just published another small patch addressing a number of issues brought up by some players.

The changes include:
- Runs with Affixes will now grant additional rewards in a form of bonus Big Chests at the end of a run, one per affix, up to a total of 4 (default one + up to 3 from affixes)
- Added a 'Help' tab in the Settings menu providing some advice and information for players seeking some assistance with the game. 
- Improved the precision of audio sliders so that the volumes can be controlled better
- Fix to the music tracks sometimes not starting another song after finishing the previous one
- Fix to the Beam attack ability breaking characters animation position on repeated use
- Small UI tweaks and improvements

More changes and improvements are on their way! Please continue sharing all the suggestions and ideas for the game, the best place to do it is on the game's [url=https://discord.gg/hNH22yqxr2]Discord Server[/url], all the feedback is greatly appreciated. Thank you!

notes.title: First Patch is Live! Thank you for sharing feedback!
notes.content:
First of all, a huge thank you to everyone giving Hell Throne a chance at this early stage and sharing their feedback! I've just published a first small patch addressing a number of issues pointed out by some of the players. 

The changes include:
- Addition of a new big chest that will be awarded at the end of each full run after defeating the final boss, that will have a high chance to drop equipment of good quality
- Higher drop chance for equipment and in better quality across the board
- Lowered overall difficulty in the first few worlds
- Improvements to character controls for better responsiveness
- Addition of a 'Dash Towards Cursor' option requested by some players (found in Settings/Controls tab)
- Improved controller navigation in the Settings tabs
- Fix to the Big Prize upgrade which used to sometimes award incorrect upgrades.
- Fix to some of the UI screens not displaying properly on Linux and Mac versions

More changes and improvements are on their way! Please continue sharing all the suggestions and ideas for the game, the best place to do it is on the game's  [url=https://discord.gg/hNH22yqxr2]Discord Server[/url], all the feedback will be greatly appreciated. Thank you!
